title: The Martyrdom of Tara Singh and His Companions

blocks.text: After darkness had momentarily shielded the survivors, visibility increased with the break of dawn and the Mughal line resumed the attack without offering any honourable closeness to the fight.
Instead they fired shots with their muskets from a distance and, once resistance ended, severed their heads from their bodies to display victory over men they could not subdue by courage alone.
The page memorializes Tara Singh along with his twenty two companions, praises their devotion openly, and then turns the reader toward Episode 87 as the next chapter in the same martyred inheritance.
